```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
hrp_status_metadata <- read_tsv("render_inputs/shared/metadata_ethiopia.tsv")
# View(hrp_status_metadata)

px1_genotype_result <- read_tsv("render_inputs/shared/px1_genotype_result.tsv") |> 
  select(Sample,"384",haplotype)
seekdeep_result <- read_tsv("render_inputs/shared/seekdeep_results.tsv.gz")

genes <- c("CRT", "PX1","Kelch13")

gene_results <- list()

for (gene in genes) {

  gene_results[[gene]] <- seekdeep_result |>
    filter(Gene == gene) |>
    # arrange is_reference so reference allele is first when arranging
    arrange(desc(is_reference)) |>
    group_by(Sample, reference_AA_pos) |>
    summarise(
      # take the first reference_AA to avoid duplicate rows for overlapping references (e.g. position 1677 in PX1)
      reference_AA = first(reference_AA),
      # collapse unique AA alleles seen for this positioning
      AA = paste0(unique(AA), collapse = "/"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      aa_id = paste0(
        reference_AA,
        reference_AA_pos,
        ifelse(reference_AA != AA, AA, "")
      ),
      gene_pos = paste0(
        gene, "_",
        stringr::str_pad(reference_AA_pos, pad = "0", width = 3)
      )
    ) |>
    select(Sample, gene_pos, aa_id) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = gene_pos,
      values_from = aa_id
    )
}

CRT_df <- gene_results$CRT
PX1_df <- gene_results$PX1
Kelch13_df <- gene_results$Kelch13



hap_countries <- c("Ethiopia", "Eritrea", "Uganda")

# samples with a SeekDeep call for each gene, so "no mutation row" can be read as wild type rather than missing data
kelch13_assayed <- seekdeep_result |> filter(Gene == "Kelch13", Country %in% hap_countries) |> distinct(Sample)
CRT_assayed     <- seekdeep_result |> filter(Gene == "CRT",     Country %in% hap_countries) |> distinct(Sample)
PX1_assayed     <- seekdeep_result |> filter(Gene == "PX1",     Country %in% hap_countries) |> distinct(Sample)

kelch13_mutant_only <- seekdeep_result |> 
  filter(Gene == "Kelch13",is_reference == "FALSE", Country %in% hap_countries) |>
  # filter(reference_AA_pos %in% c(622, 675, 680)) |>
  select(Sample, reference_AA_pos,reference_AA, AA) |>
  mutate(k13_mutation_hap = paste0("K13_", reference_AA_pos, "_", reference_AA,"/",AA)) |>
  group_by(Sample) |> 
  summarise(
    k13_mutation_hap = paste(k13_mutation_hap, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  right_join(kelch13_assayed, by = "Sample") |> 
  mutate(k13_mutation_hap = tidyr::replace_na(k13_mutation_hap, "WT"))

CRT_mutant_only <- seekdeep_result |> 
  filter(Gene == "CRT",is_reference == "FALSE", Country %in% hap_countries) |>
  select(Sample, reference_AA_pos,reference_AA, AA) |>
  mutate(crt_mutation_hap = paste0("CRT_", reference_AA_pos, "_", reference_AA,"/",AA)) |>
  group_by(Sample) |> 
  summarise(
    crt_mutation_hap = paste(crt_mutation_hap, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  right_join(CRT_assayed, by = "Sample") |> 
  mutate(crt_mutation_hap = tidyr::replace_na(crt_mutation_hap, "WT"))

PX1_mutant_only <- seekdeep_result |> 
  filter(Gene == "PX1",is_reference == "FALSE", Country %in% hap_countries) |>
  select(Sample, reference_AA_pos,reference_AA, AA) |>
  mutate(px1_mutation_hap = paste0("PX1_", reference_AA_pos, "_", reference_AA,"/",AA)) |>
  group_by(Sample) |> 
  summarise(
    px1_mutation_hap = paste(px1_mutation_hap, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  right_join(PX1_assayed, by = "Sample") |> 
  mutate(px1_mutation_hap = tidyr::replace_na(px1_mutation_hap, "WT"))

# samples with no SeekDeep call at all for a gene stay distinct from wild type in the plot legends
hap_cols <- c("k13_mutation_hap", "crt_mutation_hap", "px1_mutation_hap")
label_ungenotyped <- function(df) {
  dplyr::mutate(df, dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of(hap_cols), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, "NA")))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: ethiopia-ibd-compute
# install.packages("remotes")
# remotes::install_github("nickjhathaway/plasgenomicsutilsR")
library(plasgenomicsutilsR)
library(dplyr, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph, help, pos = 2, lib.loc = NULL)
library(ggplot2)

# Plot paths below were written relative to the parent directory. Quarto runs
# chunks from this project's root, so save them inside this project instead.
save_plot <- function(path, ...) {
  path <- sub("^ibd_specific_regions/", "", path)
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  plasgenomicsutilsR::save_plot(path, ...)
}

# Add compound helper columns to combine Site and genomic/deletion statuses
hrp_status_metadata <- hrp_status_metadata %>%
  # left_join(px1_genotype_result, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(CRT_df, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(PX1_df, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(Kelch13_df, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  mutate(Polyclonal = ifelse(fws >= 0.95, "Monoclonal", "Polyclonal")) |> 
  left_join(px1_genotype_result, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  left_join(kelch13_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  left_join(CRT_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  left_join(PX1_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  label_ungenotyped() |> 
  # compound column used for the "Site_cviet" shape grouping below
  mutate(Site_cviet = paste(Site, cviet_group, sep = " - "))


Ethiopia_ibd_results <- ibd_results(
  blocks          = file.path("render_inputs/ethiopia/Ethiopia_hmm.hmm.txt"),
  pair_fraction   = file.path("render_inputs/ethiopia/Ethiopia_ibd_fraction.pair_ibd_fraction.tsv.gz"),
  meta            = hrp_status_metadata,
  genes           = PF_EXAMPLE_DRUG_GENES,   # pfcrt, pfdhfr, pfmdr1, pfdhps, pfkelch13, pfaat1, pfgch1, pfpx1
  reference       = "pf3d7"
)

# getanyWhere(Ethiopia_ibd_results)

# 1. Genome-wide IBD Network colored by Site
Ethiopia_whole_genome_ibd_plot = Ethiopia_ibd_results$plot_ibd_pair_network(min_ibd = 0.03, color_group = "Site", shape_group = "Year")
save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures/Ethiopia_whole_genome_ibd_plot.pdf", Ethiopia_whole_genome_ibd_plot)

# 2. original pfcrt network color group = k13_mutation, shape group = cviet_group
Ethiopia_pfcrt_ibd_plot = Ethiopia_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(gene = "pfcrt", 
                                                          sharing = "complete", 
                                                          shape_group = "cviet_group",
                                                          color_group = "k13_mutation",
                                                          include_isolated = T)
save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures/Ethiopia_pfcrt_ibd_plot.pdf", Ethiopia_pfcrt_ibd_plot)

# 3. pfcrt network colored by Site
Ethiopia_pfcrt_by_site_ibd_plot = Ethiopia_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(gene = "pfcrt", 
                                                          sharing = "complete", 
                                                          shape_group = "cviet_group",
                                                          color_group = "Site",
                                                          include_isolated = T)
save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures/Ethiopia_pfcrt_by_site_ibd_plot.pdf", Ethiopia_pfcrt_by_site_ibd_plot)

# 4. pfcrt network with compound shape matching (Site + Cviet Group) and color (k13_mutation)
```

# 5. Combined Ethiopia & Eritrea Shared IBD Analysis
---

```{r,eval=F}
# 5.1 Extract Ethiopian and Eritrean sample IDs from supplementary TSV
supp_fws_up <- readr::read_tsv("render_inputs/shared/supp_fws_up.tsv", col_names = TRUE)

eth_eri_samples <- supp_fws_up |> 
    filter(Country %in% c("Ethiopia", "Eritrea")) |>
    select(sample_id) |> 
    distinct()

# Create target directories
dir.create("ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("ibd_specific_regions/output_ethiopia_eritrea", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Write the sample list for bcftools extraction
readr::write_tsv(eth_eri_samples, "ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_samples.txt", col_names = FALSE)
```

```{bash,eval=F}
# 5.2 Extract the combined Ethiopia and Eritrea samples and run hmmIBD
# Filter samples from the main country-merged population snp VCF
bcftools view -S ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_samples.txt -Oz -o ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.vcf.gz /home/metmiku/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz

# Index the extracted VCF
bcftools index ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.vcf.gz

# Convert VCF file to BCF file format
bcftools view --output-type b --output-file ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.bcf ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.vcf.gz

# Index the BCF file
bcftools index ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.bcf

# Run hmmibd-rs inside Docker in dominant-allele read mode
docker run -v /home/metmiku/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/whole_genome_scripts/snps_in_ibd_analysis/ibd_specific_regions:/data -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm hmmibd-rs:eppicenter hmmibd-rs -i /data/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.bcf --from-bcf --bcf-read-mode dominant-allele -o /data/data_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_hmm

# Extract SNP Bed coordinates
bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS0\t%END\n' ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.bcf > ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_snps.bed

# Compute IBD Fraction and SNP Density for Ethiopia + Eritrea
plasgenomicsutils ibd_fraction_and_snp_density \
  --blocks ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_hmm.hmm.txt \
  --snps   ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_snps.bed --snp-format bed \
  --output ibd_specific_regions/output_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_ibd_fraction

# Compute Fws metric across the merged sets
plasgenomicsutils calculate_fws \
  --monoclonal-threshold 0.95 \
  --input-vcf ibd_specific_regions/data_ethiopia_eritrea/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps_eth_eri_only.bcf \
  --out ibd_specific_regions/output_ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_fws.tsv
```

```{r}
# 5.3 Combined IBD Networks & Genotypic Visualizations
library(plasgenomicsutilsR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)

supp_fws_up <- readr::read_tsv("render_inputs/shared/supp_fws_up.tsv", col_names = TRUE)

# Load combined metadata and join with SeekDeep genotypes
eth_eri_metadata <- supp_fws_up %>%
  filter(Country %in% c("Ethiopia", "Eritrea")) %>%
  rename(sample = sample_id) %>%
  left_join(CRT_df, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(PX1_df, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(Kelch13_df, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  left_join(kelch13_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  left_join(CRT_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  left_join(PX1_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) |> 
  label_ungenotyped()

# Instantiate IBD Results for Eth/Eri merged dataset
Eth_Eri_ibd_results <- ibd_results(
  blocks          = file.path("render_inputs/ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_hmm.hmm.txt"),
  pair_fraction   = file.path("render_inputs/ethiopia_eritrea/eth_eri_ibd_fraction.pair_ibd_fraction.tsv.gz"),
  meta            = eth_eri_metadata,
  genes           = PF_EXAMPLE_DRUG_GENES,
  reference       = "pf3d7"
)

# 1. Genome-wide Network of Eth + Eri IBD colored by Country and shaped by Year
Eth_Eri_genome_plot <- Eth_Eri_ibd_results$plot_ibd_pair_network(min_ibd = 0.03, color_group = "Country", shape_group = "Year")
save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea/Eth_Eri_whole_genome_ibd_plot.pdf", Eth_Eri_genome_plot)

# 2. pfcrt Complete IBD Network colored by K76T mutation status (CRT_076) and shaped by Country
# Check for CRT_076 codon column availability to represent K76T status
if ("CRT_076" %in% colnames(eth_eri_metadata)) {
  Eth_Eri_pfcrt_plot <- Eth_Eri_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(
    gene = "pfcrt", 
    sharing = "complete", 
    shape_group = "Country",
    color_group = "CRT_076",
    include_isolated = TRUE
  )
  save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea/Eth_Eri_pfcrt_ibd_plot.pdf", Eth_Eri_pfcrt_plot)
}

# 3. Kelch13 Complete IBD Network colored by R622I Status (Kelch13_622) and shaped by Country
if ("Kelch13_622" %in% colnames(eth_eri_metadata)) {
  Eth_Eri_kelch_plot <- Eth_Eri_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(
    gene = "pfkelch13", 
    sharing = "complete", 
    shape_group = "Country",
    color_group = "Kelch13_622",
    include_isolated = TRUE,
    spread = 2
  )
  save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea/Eth_Eri_pfkelch13_ibd_plot.pdf", Eth_Eri_kelch_plot)
}

if ("CRT_076" %in% colnames(eth_eri_metadata)) {
  Eth_Eri_pfkelch13_hap_k13_plot <- Eth_Eri_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(
    gene = "pfcrt", 
    sharing = "complete", 
    shape_group = "CRT_076",
    color_group = "Kelch13_622",
    include_isolated = TRUE,
    spread = 2
  )
  save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea/Eth_Eri_pfcrt_k13_ibd_plot.pdf", Eth_Eri_pfkelch13_hap_k13_plot)
}


if ("k13_mutation_hap" %in% colnames(eth_eri_metadata)) {
  Eth_Eri_pfkelch13_hap_country_plot <- Eth_Eri_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(
    gene = "pfkelch13", 
    sharing = "complete", 
    shape_group = "Country",
    color_group = "k13_mutation_hap",
    include_isolated = TRUE,
    spread = 2
  )
  save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea/Eth_Eri_pfkelch13_hap_k13_ibd_plot.pdf", Eth_Eri_pfkelch13_hap_country_plot)
}

# pfcrt network colored by the CRT mutation haplotype
if ("crt_mutation_hap" %in% colnames(eth_eri_metadata)) {
  Eth_Eri_pfcrt_mutation_hap_plot <- Eth_Eri_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(
    gene = "pfcrt", 
    sharing = "complete", 
    shape_group = "Country",
    color_group = "crt_mutation_hap",
    include_isolated = TRUE
  )
  save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea/Eth_Eri_pfcrt_mutation_hap_ibd_plot.pdf", Eth_Eri_pfcrt_mutation_hap_plot)
}

# pfpx1 network colored by the PX1 mutation haplotype
if ("px1_mutation_hap" %in% colnames(eth_eri_metadata)) {
  Eth_Eri_px1_mutation_hap_plot <- Eth_Eri_ibd_results$plot_ibd_network(
    gene = "pfpx1", 
    sharing = "complete", 
    shape_group = "Country",
    color_group = "px1_mutation_hap",
    include_isolated = TRUE
  )
  save_plot("ibd_specific_regions/figures_ethiopia_eritrea/Eth_Eri_px1_mutation_hap_ibd_plot.pdf", Eth_Eri_px1_mutation_hap_plot)
}
```

```{r}
# 6.3 PX1-specific IBD network using the haplotype annotation from px1_genotype_result.tsv
library(plasgenomicsutilsR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
supp_fws_up <- readr::read_tsv("render_inputs/shared/supp_fws_up.tsv", col_names = TRUE)

px1_genotype_result <- read_tsv("render_inputs/shared/px1_genotype_result.tsv") |> 
  select(Sample,"384",haplotype)
eth_uga_metadata <- supp_fws_up %>%
  filter(Country %in% c("Ethiopia", "Uganda")) %>%
  rename(sample = sample_id) %>%
  left_join(px1_genotype_result, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(CRT_df, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(CRT_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(PX1_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  left_join(kelch13_mutant_only, by = c("sample" = "Sample")) %>%
  label_ungenotyped() %>%
  distinct()

eth_uga_px1_ibd_results <- ibd_results(
  blocks          = file.path("render_inputs/ethiopia_uganda/eth_uga_hmm.hmm.txt"),
  pair_fraction   = file.path("render_inputs/ethiopia_uganda/eth_uga_ibd_fraction.pair_ibd_fraction.tsv.gz"),
  meta            = eth_uga_metadata,
  genes           = PF_EXAMPLE_DRUG_GENES,
  reference       = "pf3d7"
)
```
